title: Ish-bosheth Murdered

questions.question: How did Ish-bosheth react to the news of Abner's death?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 4:1 (ESV): "When Ish-bosheth... heard that Abner had died at Hebron, his courage failed, and all Israel was dismayed."

questions.question: Who murdered Ish-bosheth?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 4:2, 5-6 (ESV): "...Baanah and Rechab... came into the midst of the house... and they stabbed him..."

questions.question: Where was Ish-bosheth when he was killed?
options: Lying on his bed at noon
questions.correctAnswer: Lying on his bed at noon
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 4:5 (ESV): "...who was taking his noonday rest."

questions.question: What did the assassins bring to David?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 4:8 (ESV): "And they brought the head of Ish-bosheth to David at Hebron..."

questions.question: How did David reward the assassins?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 4:12 (ESV): "And David commanded his young men, and they killed them and cut off their hands and feet..."

questions.question: What physical disability did Jonathan's son Mephibosheth have?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 4:4 (ESV): "...Jonathan, the son of Saul, had a son who was crippled in his feet."

questions.question: How old was Mephibosheth when news came of Saul and Jonathan's death?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 4:4 (ESV): "He was five years old when the news about Saul and Jonathan came from Jezreel."

questions.question: Who dropped Mephibosheth, causing his injury?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 4:4 (ESV): "...and his nurse took him up and fled... and as she fled in her haste, he fell and became lame."

questions.question: Where were Baanah and Rechab from?
Where did David bury the head of Ish-bosheth?
options: In the tomb of Abner at Hebron
questions.correctAnswer: In the tomb of Abner at Hebron
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 4:12 (ESV): "...and they took the head of Ish-bosheth and buried it in the tomb of Abner at Hebron."

questions.question: David compared the killing of Ish-bosheth to slaying which other person?
options: The messenger at Ziklag who claimed to kill Saul
questions.correctAnswer: The messenger at Ziklag who claimed to kill Saul
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 4:10 (ESV): "when one told me, 'Behold, Saul is dead,'... I seized him and killed him at Ziklag..."

questions.question: Beeroth is reckoned to which tribe?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 4:2 (ESV): "...(for Beeroth also is counted to Benjamin..."

questions.question: Where did the Beerothites flee to?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 4:3 (ESV): "...the Beerothites fled to Gittaim and have been sojourners there to this day)."

questions.question: What excuse did the assassins use to enter the house?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 4:6 (ESV): "And they came into the midst of the house as if to get wheat..."

questions.question: Where were the hands and feet of the assassins hung?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 4:12 (ESV): "...and hanged them beside the pool at Hebron."

key_verse_text: How much more, when wicked men have killed a righteous man in his own house on his bed, shall I not now require his blood at your hand and destroy you from the earth? (ESV)
